en: Color postcard showing a Romanesque/early Christian church complex within a garden. The main building has pale stone walls, red tiled roofs, rounded apses, and a high octagonal drum or baptistery-like structure in brick. A tall square bell tower in stone with a red open belfry rises on the left. Ivy climbs one lower annex, and paths curve through the landscaped garden in the foreground. Trees frame the image, and a few mid‑20th‑century apartment blocks and distant hills or mountains appear in the background. No visible printed text appears on the image side.
